description.zh: 查询指定 Group ID 时设置，否则查询所有 Group ID。
description.en: The Group ID to query. If this parameter is not specified, all Group IDs are queried.

description.zh: 分组类型，默认为 tcp，表示该 Group ID 仅适用于 TCP 协议的消息收发。
description.en: The group type. Default value: tcp, which indicates that the Group ID is applicable only to message sending and receiving over the TCP protocol.

description.zh: 需获取 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID
description.en: The instance ID that corresponds to the Group ID.
The number of entries per page.
